Playfair Display — self-hosted asset provenance

Official project: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/playfairdisplay

Assets downloaded unmodified from official Google Fonts WOFF2 responses (v40), both weight600:
PlayfairDisplay-SemiBold.woff2 — 36,336bytes, normal
PlayfairDisplay-SemiBoldItalic.woff2 — 31,284bytes, italic

The request text includes ASCII, Latin U+00A0–024F, combining accents U+0300–0304/U+0308–0309/U+0323, all precomposed Vietnamese U+1EA0–1EF9, punctuation U+2000–206F and currency/arrow symbols. It preserves Vietnamese and common Latin UI coverage without local font modifications.

Verification: both final assets have genuine wOF2 signatures. Matching same-text initial TTF responses parsed with fontTools: weight600, correct normal/italic flags,471mapped characters; required Vietnamese samples including ăâêôơưđấễộờự and capitals present. Final WOFF2 cmap was not parsed because Windows blocked an optional fontTools native module. Final browser load/render verification is performed by the parent task.
